attribution.note: Marcus describes his own view in his own post; the LLM half of the contrast is his position.

semantics.note: Faithful to the metaphor: by the time of the post, LLMs were already out of the box. Present-tense observation, no conditions.

contract.note: The plain reading (LLMs publicly released and distributed, so misuse is possible) is an ordinary reading of the Pandora's Box metaphor and fits his point about bad actors. It does not require that the feared harms already happened.

evidence.note: Meta's own dated release post (Apr 18, 2024) offers downloadable Llama 3 weights and public assistant access. This is a company disclosure, but the contract explicitly accepts developer release records for availability.

reviews.rationale: Llama 3 weights were downloadable and Meta AI was publicly available before May 17, 2024. That meets the support condition. Nothing in the packet shows LLMs were still restricted to research settings.

attribution.note: Marcus's own stated view in his post that the AGI box had not been opened.

semantics.note: Reading 'not opened' as 'AGI not achieved as of May 2024' fits the contrast he draws with LLMs, which already exist.

contract.note: Marcus gives no definition of AGI. The contract's plain reading (broad, flexible human-level competence) is ordinary and fair to him, but the result depends on that reading. Looser 'emerging AGI' definitions could count existing LLMs differently.

evidence.note: The May 17, 2024 international scientific synthesis finds frontier systems show only partial proficiency, with limitations in knowledge, reasoning and causality. That places them below broad human-level competence in the target window.
A Nov 2023 framework that is outside the target window. It shows the AGI label depends on definitions and classes then-current LLMs only as 'emerging' AGI.

Published in 2023 about an early version of GPT-4, so outside the window. It calls GPT-4 an incomplete early form of AGI based on selected demonstrations, which does not meet the contract's contradiction standard.

reviews.rationale: On the contract's fair plain reading, the contemporaneous international report (e1) describes frontier systems as only partially proficient, with substantive limitations. The most favourable items in the packet (e2, e3) still call LLMs emerging or incomplete AGI, and no item shows broad human-level competence by May 17, 2024. The result depends on the definition of AGI.
